verdict.rationale: Jeeves Cash/Global Accounts provide multi-currency accounts (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD) for receiving and holding cash, which supports local receipt of funds in major currencies, but evidence doesn't confirm local account details (e.g., local IBAN/routing numbers) per currency as opposed to a single multi-currency balance. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of local account numbers/routing details per currency, independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs, and broader currency coverage matching the 40+ currencies claimed for payments.
